items.prompt: A friend asks how your weekend away went. Which reply fits best?
options: It went fine, we drove to the coast and back.
Oh, it was brilliant, we giggled from start to finish!
items.target: Oh, it was brilliant, we giggled from start to finish!

items.prompt: Your sister texts that she passed her driving test. Which reply fits best?
options: Yes!! That's fantastic news, I'm grinning at my phone!
That's good news. Well done, take it easy tonight.
items.target: Yes!! That's fantastic news, I'm grinning at my phone!

items.prompt: A colleague asks how the product launch went. Which reply fits best?
options: It went out, but I keep waiting for something to break.
It went out, and honestly, it was an absolute delight!
items.target: It went out, and honestly, it was an absolute delight!

items.prompt: Your neighbour asks about the new puppy. Which reply fits best?
options: She's so small, we hold her close and keep her safe.
She's a little bundle of sunshine, we can't stop smiling!
items.target: She's a little bundle of sunshine, we can't stop smiling!

items.prompt: A friend asks what the concert was like last night. Which reply fits best?
options: Loud and fast, I was up and moving the whole set.
Pure bliss, I was singing and beaming the whole set.
items.target: Pure bliss, I was singing and beaming the whole set.

items.prompt: Your uncle asks how the first week at the new job went. Which reply fits best?
options: Honestly lovely, everyone's so nice and I come home smiling.
It went normally, I met the team and learned the systems.
items.target: Honestly lovely, everyone's so nice and I come home smiling.

items.prompt: A friend asks about your holiday photos from the beach. Which reply fits best?
options: That beach was heaven, we were giggling in the waves.
That was the last trip before everything changed, really.
items.target: That beach was heaven, we were giggling in the waves.

items.prompt: Your manager tells you the project has been approved. Which reply fits best?
options: Brilliant! That is the best news I've had all year!
Good. We can start whenever it suits everyone, no hurry.
items.target: Brilliant! That is the best news I've had all year!

items.prompt: A cousin asks how the wedding went on Saturday. Which reply fits best?
options: It was glorious, everyone danced and sang until midnight!
It went to plan; ceremony at two, dinner at six.
items.target: It was glorious, everyone danced and sang until midnight!

items.prompt: Your flatmate asks how your first cooking class was. Which reply fits best?
options: I burnt the sauce and kept thinking everyone was watching me.
So much fun, I burnt the sauce and couldn't stop giggling!
items.target: So much fun, I burnt the sauce and couldn't stop giggling!

items.prompt: A friend asks how the garden is doing this spring. Which reply fits best?
options: It's bursting with colour, the tulips are up and I'm thrilled!
It's coming along quietly; the tulips are up, the bees are out.
items.target: It's bursting with colour, the tulips are up and I'm thrilled!

items.prompt: Your child shows you a drawing from school. Which reply fits best?
options: Look at that! Bright colours everywhere, it made my day!
Oh, sweetheart, you worked so hard on this. Come here.
items.target: Look at that! Bright colours everywhere, it made my day!

items.prompt: A neighbour asks how the street party went. Which reply fits best?
options: Such fun, the kids danced and everyone was smiling till dark.
Non-stop, we set up at eight and ran it hard till dark.
items.target: Such fun, the kids danced and everyone was smiling till dark.

items.prompt: Your friend asks how the reunion dinner was. Which reply fits best?
options: It was hard; so many faces missing from the table.
Fabulous, we laughed so hard the waiter joined in!
items.target: Fabulous, we laughed so hard the waiter joined in!

items.prompt: A colleague asks how your morning run went. Which reply fits best?
options: Five kilometres, about half an hour, then breakfast.
Gorgeous sunrise, I was beaming the whole way round!
items.target: Gorgeous sunrise, I was beaming the whole way round!

items.prompt: Your grandmother asks how the new flat looks. Which reply fits best?
options: It's two rooms, Gran, south-facing, near the station.
It's lovely, Gran, full of light, I adore it!
items.target: It's lovely, Gran, full of light, I adore it!
